note: XVII listening-0 tears (Ian, 17 Nov, second ask).

beats.text: Retouch the painting so that the young woman's cheeks are dry: paint out the shiny wet streaks running down her face completely, leaving only a slight reddening and moistness at the rims of her eyes, as if she has just been crying. Keep her face, expression, pose, hand, headphones, hair, dress, lamp and lighting exactly the same.
